title: Python: A4 from m import m binds the attribute when m is a module file (DEC-303 (a22) item 3, (a23) step 4)
description: A from-import whose source module is a module FILE name.py and whose imported name equals the file's own name (from ._emoji_replace import _emoji_replace, from .render import render) is read as the module itself, so calling it lands module-called (name bin). By (a22) item 3 A4 is admitted for a module file only: the name resolves to the symbol the file defines, re-exports followed; a package name/__init__.py stays unresolved, and from . import name (the submodule) stays a module. 30 sites on rich at dev be867ec (4 in-package). Also carries the #144 follow-ups NB-2/NB-3/NB-4 and the GCLI-91 note correction (product callBins use markerDirs: flask 846 -> 1067 in-repo, not the no-marker 833 -> 1054).

acceptanceCriteria.text: from .m import m and from pkg.m import m, with or without an alias, in a module file that defines m resolve the call to that symbol, red before and green after
negative controls stay unresolved or module: a package __init__ named m, from . import m (the submodule), and a module file that does not define the name
GCLI-93 acceptance criteria are honestly checked and the task closed, README Limits names the GCLI-93 instrumentation, and GCLI-91 carries the markerDirs correction

implementationNotes: A4 built (DEC-303 (a22) item 3). calls.ts isSameNameAttribute: from m import m binds the attribute when the target is the module FILE m.py (never m/__init__.py), the from-module's last segment equals the name, and the file defines or re-exports it (symbolInModuleOrReexport); used at resolveImportBinding and resolveModuleAttribute. Red commit 0ef621d (4 failing fixtures; 3 negative controls pass). Rich at dev: resolvedInRepo 5485 -> 5515 and nameNotBound 353 -> 323, exactly the 30 A4 sites; flask, jinja, httpx, tqdm bins unchanged (uninstrumented analyzer with markerDirs).

ROUND 1 FIXES (#145 at 513d986). R1: A4 now gates on the SOURCE module file: sourceModuleFile resolves the from-module (absolute via modulePathByName, relative via the importer's package and dots) and requires it to be a non-__init__ file named name.py that defines or re-exports the name; a package source with a same-named submodule and a namespace directory with a same-named submodule bind the submodule (module-called, as before the PR). R2 red commit: 2 failing fixtures (package source, absolute and relative, empty and non-empty __init__; namespace directory). N1: the re-export test relabelled and a case added where the module file re-exports from a same-named file in another package; N2: an assignment-only variant (helper = make()) hits the false branch; N3 moot. RE-MEASURE with markerDirs, all five repos: bins identical to the first head (rich resolvedInRepo 5485 -> 5515, nameNotBound 353 -> 323; flask, jinja, httpx, tqdm unchanged), so the A4 delta is still the 30 sites and none of rich's 30 came from the misfire shape (the corrected gate yields the same counts as the first head).

ROUND 2 FIXES (#145 at c8255f9). REQUIRED-1: a re-export hop through a package bound the function where Python binds the submodule (pkg/helper.py 'from .sub import helper' with pkg/sub/helper.py defining helper). symbolInModuleOrReexport now applies the same module-file discrimination at every from-import hop (a hop whose target is a same-named file binds a symbol only if isSameNameAttribute holds for that hop), with the depth threaded through the gate so a cycle terminates (cycle fixture added). Red commit 347f643 (the hop fixture: absolute and relative hop and use, empty and x=1 __init__), green after. NB-2: the assignment-only test asserts module-called and not run-time-bound; NB-3 relabelled; NB-4: positives for a module file inside a single-portion namespace directory (absolute and relative), an aliased negative and a relative namespace negative. NB-1 STATED LIMIT: the source module is found by name through modulePathByName (first-wins over path-sorted modules), not carried from modules.ts, so a dead pkg/helper.py beside a package pkg/helper/ (walkFrom is package-first) or an importer under a shadowed root can pick a different file than Python; contrived, conservative only where the named file is not a module file defining the name. RE-MEASURE with markerDirsFor, five repos: bins identical to the previous head (rich resolvedInRepo 5485 -> 5515, nameNotBound 353 -> 323; flask, jinja, httpx, tqdm unchanged): the A4 delta is still the 30 rich sites.
